data.content_ref: inline:contradicts: The isolated artifact's single-run perturbation test contradicts SRC_003's claim that neither separation nor any single-run procedural criterion is sufficient for genuine independent verification, because a single trajectory cannot statistically distinguish a genuine process from a biased one. The isolated artifact asserts diagnostic sufficiency where SRC_003 asserts n=1 insufficiency. Refuted if a single-run ablation can be shown to have sufficient power to distinguish a restater from a genuine verifier at conventional significance levels without requiring a population of trials.
